description: This PHP source file, platformsView.php, manages the display and user interaction for platform management in the TestLink open-source testing management project. It initializes necessary components, sets up the view, and contains helper functions for argument initialization and rights checking.

classes.name: tlPlatform
classes.description: A class used for managing platform data, initialized with database connection and project ID, responsible for setting up the platform view GUI.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: A class used for rendering the user interface with templates.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and returns arguments object containing current user info and project IDs, throwing an exception if project ID is invalid.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the user has rights to manage or view platforms in the project.
